scope:
Hash/read/AST-only preparation of the R47 endpoint model and R48 transfer.

No endpoint checkpoint is invented or loaded as a model.  The q060 binding
is read solely for already recorded original source hashes.  No new module,
core, projection, flow, integral, tail, BVP or mathematical probe is executed.
source_registry_scope: Read only the original source identities; the old q060 curve is not a new endpoint or numerical input.

interface.required_anchor: A genuine completed M8 lambda=1 prefix/actual-tail/physical-quintic checkpoint, not yet available for this preparation.
interface.new_mode_range: Integer M>=8; every new model uses the unchanged full-lift and original parameter equations.
interface.core_initialization: model.initialize_core() is a future explicit original initial(p) call, not part of this preparation.
interface.source_old_parameters: Copy old p[1:8] literally; new p[0]=0, append zero controls; assert the first seven pscales and physical c bits.
interface.p0_scope: Original fixed=True p0=log(q_actual/qseed) remains free. Frozen profile does not imply frozen q/controls.
interface.profile_rebase: Use the actual frozen_profile once, with the old delta p0 already incorporated.
interface.new_actual_tail: Require a real M-dimensional original DN/Jac/audit response; no old response or J is embedded.
interface.state_transfer: EndpointStateTransfer(model): blockwise physical-PPoly embedding plus a*chi*(I_new-E*I_old).
interface.physical_jets: Retain the original a, a_s, a_ss and quintic window derivatives, including the 2*a_s*chi_s cross term.
interface.normalized_mesh: The old physical PPoly mesh is mapped through the new original inverse_chart. Old variable-profile raw t is not presumed identical.
interface.zero_window: Copy embedded state jets without a floating addition when their reference factor is exactly zero.
interface.mean_scope: No mean primitive copied or recomputed; no whole physical map identity inferred from planar compensation alone.
interface.interpolation_scope: A continuous callable state is prepared; no new quintic is claimed to equal this non-polynomial function.
interface.finite_core_scope: Defining-core nesting is mathematical; no cross-M floating inversion/projection identity is assumed.
